correctness.rationale: The two source endpoint products (Thm.5.3, eq.(5.20)) are exactly equivalent for equal h=s/m to a scalar F_m(s)=0 and its c_m(s); all variables and normalization are from the source. The finite products converge in C1 on compact s-intervals to the exponential F_infty. Strict simple F_infty root guarantees s_m for EVERY sufficiently large integer m and c_m→c*. Source strict conditions (5.15), conic (5.18), κ<v and nonzero recovery denominator persist; Theorem5.3 yields exactly 3(m+1) pairwise distinct positive NS triangles and valid coordinate-minimal container, not merely a zero-scale continuous family. The source E_{j,m} formula and uniform denominator separation justify total scale right Riemann sum. At rational d=0.415868, τ=0.67376 the inspected outward-directed integer interval source was independently replayed with exact directed Fraction intervals on a 10^38 grid, including strict sign/transversality/positivity and 16384 upper-rectangle comparisons (S_upper≈0.9404652351773 < 0.940465236); independent 60-digit root/integral gives s*=1.11018332497810, S∞≈0.94046231356648, λ∞≈1.06330682854>1.0633. Exact inequality depends on the rational interval certificate, not decimal quadrature.
